summary: Ran a backend-only E2E check of the RapidAPI to Linkly swap on the dev bot using the mock Telegram harness and the real Linkly API. All 6 requested checks passed. (1) pytest: 12 passed. (2) /api/dev/shortlink-analytics-test returned ok:true and linklyShowsNA:true. (3) New sim user 7700000001 went through onboarding, URL Shortener, Shortit (Trial), sent a URL and tapped Random Short Link. The bot replied https://linkly.link/2y2gr, which returned 302 to the exact destination. The log had '[Shortener] Linkly success', no RapidAPI text appeared, and the bot sent 'You have 4 of 5 trial Shortit links remaining.' (4) View Shortlink Analytics showed '📊 analytics not available (linkly.link) → https://linkly.link/2y2gr → <dest>'. (5) With LINKLY_WORKSPACE_ID="1", user 7700000002 got 'Link shortening failed. Please try again or tap 💬 Support.'. Admin 5590563715 got '⚠️ Linkly URL shortener failed:\nLinkly error (404): Not found', the log had '[Shortener] Linkly failed: Linkly error (404): Not found', and the counter stayed at 5/5. (6) Quick-shorten via 'Shorten Now' returned https://vault-launch-6.preview.emergentagent.com/api/g0ZkR and made no Linkly call. Cleanup: only 1 Linkly link was created and it was deleted (now returns 404). The user's link 2y2V3 still returns 302 to google.com. backend/.env is byte-identical to the pre-test backup. The mock was killed, nodejs restarted and healthy, and the real webhook was left untouched.

minor.issue: Bug that existed before this change, not related to Linkly. The code calls get(state, chatId, 'preferredShortenerDomain'), but db.get(c, key) only takes 2 arguments, so it returns the user's whole state document. The 'object' self-heal branch then picks the first string field that contains a '.' (the user's last URL) and saves it as preferredShortenerDomain. Reproduced: after a Shortit run the submenu shows '🌐 Default domain: https://example.com/?nomadly_e2e=...'. The same wrong 3-argument call is at L15752, L22284 and L22360. Those spots are protected by activeDomains.includes(), so link creation is not affected, but the menu text is wrong and bad data is saved to the DB. Fix: read it as (await get(state, chatId))?.preferredShortenerDomain.

The log line reads '[Shortener] Linkly success: https://***/2y2gr' because the log redactor treats linkly.link as a customer domain and masks it. If you want the host readable for ops/grep, add 'linkly.link' to INFRA_SUFFIXES.

Cosmetic, existed before this change. Right after a quick-shorten the message says '4 of 5 remaining', but the main-menu keyboard sent with it still says '🔗✂️ URL Shortener — 5 Free Links' (the label is built before the counter goes down). The Shortit Random flow shows the correct '4 Free Links'.

action_items: Optional: fix the 3-argument get(state, chatId, 'preferredShortenerDomain') calls (4 places) and clean up preferredShortenerDomain values in state that are URLs, not domains.
Optional: add 'linkly.link' to INFRA_SUFFIXES in js/log-redact.js so success logs show the real host.
